title: Flood event within 24 hours example rows
limitations: No source, publisher, reuse terms, label definition, or verification evidence is recorded.
All rows share a single observation date, so chronological train/test evaluation is impossible.
There is no event identifier to keep related observations out of both train and test sets.
Feature timestamps relative to the prediction issue time are undocumented; warning and gauge fields may leak outcome information.
The five rows are an illustrative example, not a representative sample of Kochi or Kerala flood events.
The sidecar documents this repository's audit; it does not establish the CSV's source or turn its rows into verified observations.
